Getting a number of failed Bullseye builds. Believe Bullseye-Backports have moved to the Debian Archive.
@Alec Leamas ... https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/Rasbats/frcurrents_pi/379/workflows/a594c22a-b126-42a5-855b-6bbc17bcaf89
Can the scripts referenced by config.yml be adjusted for this?

We should no build bullseye any more, trixie (13) will be released soon. But there are no provisions to configure this.

In a medium term perspective we should drop the bullseye builds and add trixie instead, effectively freezing the bullseye state. The simple solution could be to just remove bulllseye stuff from .circleci/config.

Unless, of course, if we could fix the builds with a minimum effort for now. Do have examples (logs) from failed builds?
See above link.
"blushes"

bullseye-backports is EOL and removed from the archives. W should thus just stop building bullseye, freezing state to the last available builds.

Please just edit ~/.circleci/config, removing the bullseye builds for now. Currently busy handling main OpenCPN bugs, will find some time to add trixie builds later.
Thanks. Will do. Intend tagging as sd3.4.0-beta2
Right.
@Alec Leamas Please can you edit shipdriver v3.4.0 by removing the intel legacy build ready for the tag sd3.4.7? See the comment from Pavel in General Chat.
Done:

As support for legacy builds has been dropped, the attached dokowiki page needs updating by deleting the sections I have encircled in red. Not sure who can do that?
MacOS OpenCPN.pdf
@Rick Gleason ^

My JavaScript remote building is broken again. Only MacOS Universal is succeeding.
I have updated to sd3.4.6 but still no better.
Logs: CircleCI Appveyor

Can someone advise, please?

Just a simple error ?

In file included from /ci-source/src/fileOrganiser.cpp:15:
/ci-source/src/JavaScriptgui_impl.h: In constructor 'Console::Console(wxWindow*, wxString)':
/ci-source/src/JavaScriptgui_impl.h:300:25: error: expected ';' before 'wxAcceleratorTable'
  300 |                         wxAcceleratorTable accel(2, entries);
      |                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/ci-source/src/JavaScriptgui_impl.h:301:45: error: 'accel' was not declared in this scope
  301 |                         SetAcceleratorTable(accel);

In JavaScriptgui_impl.h : 

#ifdef __WXMAC__
            entries[0].Set(wxACCEL_CMD, 'F', ID_CONSOLE_FORMAT);
            entries[1].Set(wxACCEL_CMD, 'P', ID_TIDY_PARKING);
#else
            entries[0].Set(wxACCEL_CTRL, 'F', ID_CONSOLE_FORMAT);
            entries[1].Set(wxACCEL_CTRL, 'P', ID_TIDY_PARKING)
#endif
            wxAcceleratorTable accel(2, entries);
            SetAcceleratorTable(accel);
            Bind(wxEVT_MENU, &Console::OnConsoleFormat, this, ID_CONSOLE_FORMAT);
            Bind(wxEVT_MENU, &Console::OnParkingTidy, this, ID_TIDY_PARKING);
            // end of stuff for short cuts
            }
you forgot a ; after entries[1].Set(wxACCEL_CTRL, 'P', ID_TIDY_PARKING)

About bullseye builds, mine have been failing for a while :

Pavel told me to drop this build architecture...
We have dropped bullseye from shipdriver, same for linux-armhf (android-armhf is still there).

Ok so dropping bookworm-armhf and build-trixie-armhf.

Unrelated question : I believe the android builds are only for api 18 ?
Android: no idea, I don't follow those builds. But I see no reason why not use later APIs besides the usual features vs compatibility trade off.

Oh dear! Very humble apologies to @Alec Leamas and @Kupofty I should have found that. Very embarrassed :embarrassed: :embarrassed:

The windows build in sd3.4.6 was failing again. It still needs the update to wind-deps.bat from here. And it still tries to build MacOS legacy and Bullseye.

@Tony Voss
in .circleci/config.yml remove : 

      - build-macos-intel-legacy:
          <<: *std-filters

      - build-bullseye-wx32:
          <<: *std-filters

      - build-bullseye:
          <<: *std-filters

      - build-bookworm-armhf:
          <<: *std-filters

      - build-trixie-armhf:
          <<: *std-filters
